title: Idea for directed-energy UFO shootdowns came from a Roswell survivor

tellings.quote: Harold told Pippa on his deathbed and offair that the CIA and Atomic Energy Commission got the very idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy from an extraterrestrial being that survived the Roswell crash in 1947.

plain: Michels says a former presidential advisor named Harold Malmgren claimed that the CIA and the Atomic Energy Commission got the idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy, meaning beams of focused energy, from an extraterrestrial being who survived the Roswell crash of 1947. Roswell is the reported crash of a craft in New Mexico that some say was alien. According to Michels, Malmgren told this to Pippa Malmgren on his deathbed and off air. If true, it would mean a living alien helped shape early US weapons ideas.
